info.name: RentIQ — Locations + Pricing (Phase 3)
info.description:
Validation scenarios 1–7 from specs/006-locations-pricing/quickstart.md plus the Cross-Tenant Support Access (Impersonation) scenarios from specs/007-cross-tenant-support-access/. Prereqs: app running on :3002 (stage, .env.stage), migrations applied (stations/lockers/inventory_kits/tariffs tables), seed run (org slug `rentiq`, SUPER_ADMIN admin@rentiq.dev/rentiq-admin-dev, second org slug `second-org` + ORG_ADMIN admin@second-org.dev).

Collection variables: baseUrl, adminEmail, adminPassword, accessToken, orgId, stationId, lockerId1, lockerId2, kitId1, kitId2, tariffId60, tariffId120, tariffId180, orgAdminToken, targetOrgId, foreignOrgId, unknownOrgId.

The first folder (Auth) logs in as SUPER_ADMIN and sets accessToken; the Cross-Tenant Support Access folder logs in as ORG_ADMIN (orgAdminToken) and exercises the x-org-id impersonation gate (V1–V5); the remaining folders walk through the Phase 3 locations + pricing scenarios against the MockSmartLockGateway (no HA required).

item.name: Login as ORG_ADMIN admin@second-org.dev (200, sets orgAdminToken)
V1: SUPER_ADMIN impersonates rentiq org via x-org-id (200)
V3: SUPER_ADMIN with unknown org → 404 ORG_NOT_FOUND
V4: SUPER_ADMIN with suspended org → 403 ORG_SUSPENDED
V5: ORG_ADMIN own org, no header (200, unchanged behavior)
Org Credentials — Monobank + Checkbox + Payment Details
PATCH /organizations/:id/payment-creds (set Monobank tokens, encrypted on server)

exec: pm.test('tokens masked in response', () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.paymentCreds.testToken).to.match(/^\*{4}/); pm.expect(b.paymentCreds.enabled).to.eql(true); });
pm.test('payment details stored', () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.paymentDetails.iban).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('iban')); });
pm.test('checkbox tokens masked', () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.checkboxConfig.licenseKey).to.match(/^\*{4}/); pm.expect(b.checkboxConfig.enabled).to.eql(true); });
pm.test('all tokens masked', () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.paymentCreds.testToken).to.match(/^\*{4}/); pm.expect(b.checkboxConfig.licenseKey).to.match(/^\*{4}/); });

item.name: Scenario 1 — Admin creates station, lockers, kits, tariffs
POST /stations (201, defaults: isActive=true, isVisibleToClients=false, WORKING, UNKNOWN)

exec: pm.test('defaults applied', () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.isActive).to.eql(true); pm.expect(b.isVisibleToClients).to.eql(false); pm.expect(b.workingStatus).to.eql('WORKING'); pm.expect(b.healthStatus).to.eql('UNKNOWN'); pm.expect(b.autoLockDelaySec).to.eql(30); });

item.name: GET /stations admin list (200, includes the station)
Scenario 2 — Renter sees bookable stations + lockers

exec: pm.test('exactly one bookable station', () => { const items = pm.response.json().items; pm.expect(items.length).to.eql(1); pm.expect(items[0].availableLockersCount).to.eql(2); pm.expect(items[0].displayStatus).to.eql('AVAILABLE'); });

item.name: GET /stations/:id/lockers (200, 2 bookable lockers with 3 tariffs each)

exec: pm.test('2 bookable lockers', () => { const items = pm.response.json().items; pm.expect(items.length).to.eql(2); pm.expect(items[0].kitType).to.eql('SUP_BOARD'); pm.expect(items[0].tariffs.length).to.eql(3); });

item.name: Negative: hide station → disappears from renter view

exec: pm.test('price + tariffId', () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.priceMinor).to.eql(10000); pm.expect(b.currency).to.eql('UAH'); pm.expect(b.tariffId).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('tariffId60')); });

pm.test('price updated, key unchanged', () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.priceMinor).to.eql(12000); pm.expect(b.kitType).to.eql('SUP_BOARD'); pm.expect(b.durationMinutes).to.eql(60); });

item.name: POST /lockers/:id/close again (idempotent — no double-lock error, FR-015)

exec: pm.test('health fields present', () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.healthStatus).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(b.adminIntendedIsActive).to.be.a('boolean'); pm.expect(b.isActiveForBookability).to.be.a('boolean'); });
